name: Steel Weight Calculator
description: Calculate the weight of steel plates based on dimensions and material density. Used in structural design, fabrication, and cost estimation.

seo.title: Steel Weight Calculator - Free Online Engineering Tool
seo.description: Calculate steel weight instantly — Beams, plates, rounds & sections with metric + imperial unit support

formula.explanation: Weight = Length × Width × Thickness × Density. The engine converts all dimensions to SI base units (meters). Result is in kilograms.

content.introduction: Calculate steel plate weight from dimensions and material density. This calculator supports carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum and other common engineering materials.

example.description: A 1000×1000×10mm carbon steel plate weighs 78.5 kg

faq.q: What is the density of carbon steel?
faq.a: Carbon steel density is approximately 7850 kg/m³.

faq.q: What is the density of stainless steel 304?
faq.a: Stainless steel 304 has a density of approximately 7930 kg/m³.
This calculator gives theoretical weight based on nominal dimensions. Actual weight may vary slightly due to manufacturing tolerances.
